name: Tandou no Ori
source:
A heroine spurred by jealousy and anger captures you and another girl for sexual training! 
Your lewd prayers and expectations flow together, and await you in a gloomy basement room. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054085.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一名因嫉妒与愤怒失去理智的女主角，将你和另一个女孩抓起来进行性调教！你们淫乱的祈求与期待交融在一起，在阴暗的地下室中等待着你。
